DESCRIPTION: When a marked character takes damage, they lose an equal amount of HP.
When a corroded character takes damage, a random enemy gains an equal amount of Poison.
When Bleed is applied, lose HP equal to the current Bleed amount.
When attacked this turn, play the top cards of your draw pile at the start of your next turn.
Taking attack damage adds Stress. At 100 Stress, a hero's resolve is tested; at 200, they die of a heart attack.
A stunned character skips their next turn and gains Artifact equal to their Stun.
For a set number of turns, healing received is increased by 50%.
At the end of the turn, a plagued character spreads Plague to a random character and takes damage. If they spread it to themselves, they gain Poison instead.
Cards with #yRoar N last for N turns and trigger at the start of each turn.
Higher #yBrightness reduces damage taken, positive effect chances, and loot. Lower #yBrightness increases damage taken, positive effect chances, and loot.
Playing a card with #ySteam also triggers the effect of the previously played #ySteam card.
